_source: Notion page 20 - WhatsApp Message Templates (11 Oct 2026). Wording owner: Architect. Edits marked in _changes.
_changes: oerf_transfer_escalation: body no longer starts with a variable; {{1}}/{{2}} swapped
oerf_approval_reminder: added closing sentence so the body does not end with a variable
oerf_callback_request: added closing sentence so the body does not end with a variable
oerf_transfer_confirm_request: added 'by tapping below' so the body does not end with a variable

templates.name: oerf_driver_checkin
templates.body: Shipment {{1}} is at {{2}}°C, above its safe range. Please pull over safely before replying. Is the refrigeration unit running?

templates.name: oerf_driver_reminder
templates.body: Reminder for shipment {{1}}: the temperature is still above its safe range. When it is safe to do so, please tell us whether the refrigeration unit is running.

templates.name: oerf_driver_reroute
templates.body: Please take shipment {{1}} to {{2}}, about {{3}} minutes away. They are expecting you. Directions: {{4}} Tap below when you are on your way.

templates.name: oerf_supervisor_escalation
templates.body: The driver of shipment {{1}} has not replied for {{2}} minutes during a temperature alert. Please contact the driver and check they are safe.

templates.name: oerf_reroute_ack_escalation
templates.body: The driver of shipment {{1}} has not confirmed the new route to {{2}}. Please contact the driver, because the facility is expecting the truck.

templates.name: oerf_ops_approval
templates.body: Shipment {{1}} needs a decision. Cause: {{2}}. Recommended: divert to {{3}}, {{4}} minutes away, which keeps it within the excursion allowance. Do you approve?

templates.name: oerf_approval_reminder
templates.body: Reminder: the diversion of shipment {{1}} to {{2}} is waiting for your approval. If there is no reply by {{3}}, the next step is: {{4}}. Please reply below.

templates.name: oerf_auto_proceed_notice
templates.body: No reply was received, so the diversion of shipment {{1}} to {{2}} went ahead within the pre-approved limits. No action is needed unless you want to change it.

templates.name: oerf_ops_escalation_options
templates.body: Shipment {{1}} needs your decision: {{2}}. Please choose an option on the dashboard as soon as possible.
examples: no approved facility can take it within the allowance

templates.name: oerf_transfer_escalation
templates.body: The transfer of shipment {{1}} has not been confirmed by {{2}}. Please check with them, and confirm the transfer on the dashboard once it is done.

templates.name: oerf_facility_request
templates.body: Emergency cold storage request for shipment {{1}}. Required range: {{2}}. Expected arrival in about {{3}} minutes. Can you accept it?

templates.name: oerf_facility_reminder
templates.body: Reminder: shipment {{1}} needs emergency cold storage at {{2}} within about {{3}} minutes. Please accept or decline so we can plan.

templates.name: oerf_transfer_confirm_request
templates.body: Shipment {{1}} should now be with you. Please confirm once it is in controlled storage at {{2}} by tapping below.

templates.name: oerf_qa_report_ready
templates.body: The excursion report for shipment {{1}} is ready. Maximum temperature {{2}}°C, {{3}} minutes above the limit (allowance {{4}} minutes). Cause: {{5}}. Please review the report and record your decision.

templates.name: oerf_qa_reminder
templates.body: Reminder: the excursion report for shipment {{1}} is waiting for your decision. The product stays on hold until it is recorded.

templates.name: oerf_qa_prewarn
templates.body: Advance notice: shipment {{1}} is likely to exceed its excursion allowance of {{2}} minutes. The team is working on it, and the full report will follow.

templates.name: oerf_status_update
templates.body: Update on shipment {{1}}: {{2}}. Next step: {{3}}. No action is needed from you.

templates.name: oerf_reopen_alert
templates.body: Shipment {{1}} has risen above its safe range again at {{2}} ({{3}}°C). The incident is reopened and the team is responding. Any earlier QA request is withdrawn, and an updated report will follow.

templates.name: oerf_callback_request
templates.body: Please call the {{1}} for shipment {{2}} on {{3}}. They asked for a call during an active temperature alert. Next automatic step: {{4}}. Tap below when you call.

templates.name: oerf_incident_cancelled
templates.body: The alert for shipment {{1}} has been closed by the operations team ({{2}}). No further action is needed. Thank you for your help.
